rules: 1. Be kind. Disagree with ideas, not people.
2. Stay on-topic per channel; use #lounge for everything else.
3. Privacy: never paste API keys, secrets, or proprietary code in this server — not in help requests, not in screenshots.
4. No spam, crypto shilling, or unsolicited DMs.
5. Search #help and the issue tracker before opening a new question.
welcomeMessage: Welcome to forge — the open-source CLI coding agent you can extend at every layer. Say hi in #general, read #rules, and if you're here to build plugins, #plugin-dev is your channel. Docs: https://inbesat.github.io/Munchkin-CLI/
